title: ChainAlytix Visibility Portal
summary: Designed a supply chain visibility portal concept focused on shipment tracking, delivery confirmation, exception monitoring, and operational transparency.
problem: Supply chain teams often struggle with fragmented shipment visibility, incomplete delivery confirmation, and delayed exception awareness.
solution: Designed a supply chain visibility portal concept that supports shipment submission, delivery confirmation, exception monitoring, audit tracking, and operational visibility.
value: Demonstrates the ability to translate operational challenges into a structured system architecture and detailed design solution.

title: Chilly's React Storefront
summary: Built a React storefront with product browsing, product detail pages, shopping cart functionality, JSON-based product data, and responsive design.
problem: Small businesses need a responsive online storefront that allows customers to browse inventory, view detailed product information, and manage selected items.
solution: Developed a React-based storefront application featuring reusable components, routing, shopping cart functionality, and responsive layouts.
value: Demonstrates front-end development skills including routing, state management concepts, responsive design, and component-based architecture.

title: MyPFA Database
summary: Designed and implemented a SQL Server database to manage bills, payment sources, schedules, categories, alerts, and financial reporting.
problem: Financial obligations can become difficult to manage when bills, payment schedules, alerts, and payment methods are spread across disconnected systems.
solution: Designed a normalized SQL Server database capable of managing financial obligations, payment schedules, alerts, reporting, and payment source tracking.
value: Demonstrates database architecture, SQL development, relational modeling, and reporting capabilities.

title: Python Expense Tracker
summary: Developed a menu-driven Python application for tracking expenses, generating reports, filtering data, and managing backups.
problem: Users need a practical way to record, organize, filter, summarize, and preserve personal expense information.
solution: Built a Python application featuring expense entry, category filtering, reporting, data persistence, backup functionality, and recovery capabilities.
value: Demonstrates practical software development, user interaction, data management, and problem-solving skills.
